logical_checks.name: spectral_projection_domination
logical_checks.statement: For P=1_{|A|>=1}, A^2-P is PSD, hence (A^2)_ii>=P_ii.

logical_checks.name: three_bank_greedy
logical_checks.statement: If each q_j<w and sum q_j>S0, minimal greedy banks J1,J2 at level a=(S0-2w)/3 have mass <a+w, leaving >a for J3.

logical_checks.name: pure_star_inertia
logical_checks.statement: If A=D+S, ||D||op<tau and S=[[0,c^T],[c,0]], then n_+(A-tau I)<=n_+(S)<=1 and n_+(-A-tau I)<=n_+(-S)<=1.

logical_checks.name: probabilistic_provenance
logical_checks.statement: P is used only deterministically; all leaf banks J_k and all D5/Pluecker conditioning are original-coordinate banks.

logical_checks.name: correction_regression
logical_checks.statement: No pointwise phase-decay claim, unrestricted fiber supremum, post-rotation independence, deletion of small random quadratic terms, or single-good-minor inference is used.
